name: Simon's Bounded Rationality and Satisficing
axiom: People accept the first option that clears their threshold rather than searching for the best.
trigger: People page through all forty search results because nothing marks which listing is good enough to take.

checklist.text: Surface a clearly marked top pick with its rating or badge above the result list.
Show the criteria that make an option acceptable beside it, not one detail page away.
Keep essential filters visible instead of requiring a boolean query to narrow the set.

antiPattern.violation: A hotel search makes people open all forty listings because none shows rating, cancellation terms, and price together.
antiPattern.remediation: A Top Pick card above the grid shows rating, cancellation terms, and verified price for those dates.

academicOrigin.title: Rational Choice and the Structure of the Environment
